channel.title: Shah Spectrum
channel.description:
There's more to a headline than the headline.
Shah Spectrum is a daily briefing on finance, macroeconomy and technology. Each episode takes one story from the news and explains what happened, why it happened and why it matters, in about five minutes. No jargon, no hype, and no advice on what to buy or sell.
Narrated by an AI-generated voice. Made to explain the news, not as investment advice.
channel.itunes:subtitle: Finance, macroeconomy and tech, one layer deeper.

item.title: India's emergency fund: why forex reserves fell
item.description: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by more than eight billion dollars in a single week, to about 726 billion dollars. We explain what the reserves are, why they move, and what the fall means for India. Explanation only, not investment advice. Narrated by an AI-generated version of Mittal Shah's voice.

item.title: Tesla's flying Roadster: spectacle or strategy?
item.description: Tesla unveiled a new Roadster that jumps, flips and lands using SpaceX-built thrusters. We explain how the technology works, why it is a showpiece rather than the real business, and what it signals for the car industry and for India. Explanation only, not investment advice. Narrated by an AI-generated version of Mittal Shah's voice.

item.title: Why the RBI raised interest rates while growth is strong
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% and said rate cuts are off the table for now. We explain why it moved, what changed in its stance, and what it means for borrowers. Explanation only, not investment advice. Narrated by an AI-generated voice.
